title: Natural Blueberry Juice (No Added Sugar)
excerpt: Enjoy a refreshing natural blueberry juice with no added sugar. Natural sweetness, vibrant color and easy to make to go with your mornings.
imageAlt: Glass with deep purple natural blueberry juice and ice on a wooden table.
steps: Wash the blueberries and place them directly in the blender jar.
Add the 2 cups of cold water, the lemon juice and the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the cold mountains of Guasca to guarantee their perfect sweetness.
Blend on high speed for 1 to 2 minutes until the mixture is completely smooth.
Pour the juice through a fine strainer if you prefer a light texture, or serve it unstrained if you want to take advantage of all the natural fiber of the fruit.
Serve in tall glasses with ice cubes and enjoy it right away, ice cold.
tips: Thanks to the natural sweetness of Fresh Pick high-mountain blueberries, this juice needs no added sugar or sweeteners.
If you freeze the blueberries a few hours before blending them, you will get a super-cold juice with a slightly frappé texture without diluting the flavor.
